verdict.rationale: The Cactus engine documents hybrid routing that sends hard queries to the cloud automatically based on local model confidence, and a user reports running Cactus Hybrid with a confidence score. This is a real cloud-offload path, but it is triggered by confidence, not by insufficient hardware. The hosted GPUs in the pricing docs are for fine-tuning and training, not inference, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented user-selectable hosted inference tier for very large models, which cloud models are served, offload triggered by local hardware limits, a no-download guarantee, independent hands-on corroboration of the cloud fallback.
